top_signals.title: Marin: YPF Eyes November Deal with XRG and Eni
top_signals.summary: YPF Chairman and CEO Horacio Marin says the company is working with Eni and XRG and aims to sign an agreement by the end of November. Marin spoke to Bloomberg’s Abeer Abu Omar about the project and the need for more energy supply amid conflicts in the Middle East and the Russia-Ukraine war. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: CVR Energy Nears $4 Billion Refinery Deal With Marathon
top_signals.summary: Marathon Petroleum is nearing a deal for the sale of several refineries to CVR Energy, with the sale expected to be worth $4 billion, the Wall Street Journal has reported, citing unnamed sources. The deal could be announced later today. The refining sector has become the star of the oil industry this year as the wars in the Persian Gulf and Russia-Ukraine have severely crippled global fuel supply, prompting refiners outside the war zones to boost their output. top_signals.title: Amer: BGN Investing in Ships as Iran War Disrupts Trade
top_signals.summary: BGN is investing in more vessels, including VLCCs, as shipping companies navigate disruptions from the Iran war. Wael Amer, group chief operating officer at BGN, spoke to Bloomberg’s Abeer Abu Omar about the company’s investments aimed at helping the energy trader continue reaching customers during difficult market conditions. (Source: Bloomberg)
